pr_title: Font size changing in editor help section
pr_body: Made font size changing work in the editor's help section, which was previously not affected by `main_font_size`. Fixes #35269 .
pr_comments:
Well...

As you can see from the code you're removing, there's actually a dedicated option for setting the help font sizes. With this change you're removing its use, thus making the still existing options inactive.

So from your findings, there are 3 options:
- Either #35269 should be closed because it's a misunderstanding and it's already possible to change doc font sizes, just with another settings,
- Or given that the misunderstanding hints at a discoverability problem, the help font sizes could be moved next to the general editor font sizes,
- Or doc font sizes can indeed be made dependent on the main font size, but then you should remove the settings specific to doc fonts.
@johnnygossdev suggested that I should not introduce a new option to the settings, but rather scale it with `main_font_size`.

Given that we currently have 6 `Font Size` settings (1 basic font, 1 for the code editor, 3 for the help section, 1 for the output) in 3 different places, I would prefer grouping everything font related as a new `Font` tab. Currently, it's just confusing.

We can probably remove all the help font size settings and multiply the main font size instead, rounding it up to the nearest integer. The multipliers should be adjusted so the default font size setting (14) gives the same help font sizes as before.
Ah I see the different fonts size options. I should have done a search - I just expected the fonts to be in the same place :sweat_smile:
As suggested by @johnnygossdev and @Calinou I simply removed the useless settings.

@noname1477 It seems some files have been moved to the wrong directories, causing the diff to become very large. `editor_settings.{cpp,h}` and `editor_fonts.{cpp,h}` should be placed back in `editor/` instead of the root directory.
@Calinou Oh, sorry, I didn't see that. I'm still pretty new to GitHub, so I make this mistake all the time.

issue_context.title: Text in the help section of the editor doesn't scale with font settings
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2.rc1

**OS/device including version:**
Linux / Pop_OS

**Issue description:**
The text in the help section of the editor stays the same size no matter if `main_font_size` is changed in the editor settings.
![help_font](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3285214/72661841-13227a80-39d7-11ea-95c2-14bc574e9fa4.png)
![help_font2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3285214/72661894-d30fc780-39d7-11ea-815a-499738d2e625.png)

**Steps to reproduce:**
Open a new project, navigate to the help section and alter `main_font_size` in the editor settings.

**Minimal reproduction project:**
comments:
This is happening in the code editor, too. I'm looking into it.
![font_thing](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/54987242/72664059-bdab9500-39f9-11ea-8233-5b877f84ea25.PNG)

@noname1477 Changing `code_font_size` does work as intended for me. 

However neither `main_font_size` nor `code_font_size` changes the help text.
Just re-downloaded it and now the code size works. Would you think it is a good idea to make the help text follow `main_font_size` or should I introduce a new option?
I don't think a new option is necessary. Seems it should just scale with `main_font_size`.
I think this issue should be closed, the help section's text can already be modified by another setting and this issue may confuse newer programmers with the Junior Job tag.

I don't see it mentioned clearly so to clarify, the font size for the help section is configured with those settings:

![Screenshot_20210309_135529](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4701338/110473730-257ddd00-80df-11eb-8c74-d4348b394b7b.png)

The issue is fixed in `master` with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/73106. The fix cannot be cherrypicked, but a similar fix can be made for `3.x` if it doesn't work there either. Though indeed, the discussion above seems to be about the wrong settings.

review_comments:
Won't this set the default title font size to 27 where it was previously 23? 27 may be a bit too large. (The default font size is 14.)

Other than that, this PR looks good to me now.
